issued_to: Claude Code agent (Claude Opus 5.5), agent session of 2026-10-09 in this repository

source.form: The same written brief as DOA-2026-10-09-1 and DOA-2026-10-09-2 (given by the operator in the agent session on 2026-10-09, titled 'CO.PRE.PAN 3.0 - Autonomous Acquisition: Safe Recovery, Delegated Operator & Three-Wave Execution'). The canary of DOA-2026-10-09-2 (wave-c2) was armed and frozen and stopped on a defect of this project at its first answer: the day's pack of hn_criterio had been sealed by wave C1 and the driver could not record into it. Two requests had been made to criterio.hn (its robots file and its feed); no item was requested, nothing was recorded. The defect is repaired and regression-tested offline. This record is the bounded repetition the brief allows after such a repair, within what is left of the C2 limits. It is written by the commissioned agent; it is the agent's transcription of the operator's commission, not a document signed by the operator, and it grants nothing the brief does not: the same two outlets, the same item limits, and a lower limit for other requests.
authorising_clauses: Phase C2 - Artikelaufnahme aus HTML-Listings: Auch diese zweite Stufe wird durch den vorliegenden Auftrag ausdrücklich autorisiert, jedoch ausschließlich unter folgenden zusätzlichen Bedingungen. [...] Maximal zehn zusätzliche Item-Requests je betroffenem Outlet, höchstens 90 zusätzliche Item-Requests für C2 insgesamt.

Falls ein eigener Softwarefehler auftritt, gezielt reparieren und offline regressionsprüfen. Ein weiterer Live-Versuch ist nur innerhalb einer gültigen Autorisierung und der verbleibenden Budgets zulässig.

Nach jeder Phase eigenständig entscheiden: direkte Fortsetzung; kleiner deterministischer Repair; begrenzte erneute Validierung; einzelner Outlet zurückstellen; betroffene Phase wegen eines tatsächlich relevanten Gates stoppen.

Für Discovery- und sonstige Nicht-Item-Requests gelten die bisherigen strengen Canary-Budgets. Eine zusätzliche oder erneute Discovery ist nur zulässig, soweit sie zur vorgesehenen C2-Qualifizierung erforderlich und innerhalb der geltenden Limits ausdrücklich abgedeckt ist.

actions_authorized: turn external_acquisition on for exactly one canary of the wave and off again
run the tests on the arming commit, build the canary baseline of that commit and freeze it by its digest under this record
read again the registered channels of the wave's two outlets within the wave's lowered non-item limit
request at most ten item pages per outlet that the outlet's reviewed allow rule of config/candidate_rules.json qualifies
preserve, verify, replay, measure, commit and push the evidence
not_authorized: any outlet other than the two of the wave
any section, category, archive year, domain or origin beyond the registered channels of the two outlets
any request beyond the wave's limits; a further repetition under this record: if this canary stops again, C2 is deferred with its cause
any request to an origin under a hold; no way around a bot challenge, a paywall, a registration wall or a robots decision
general production activation, a scheduled or repeated acquisition, a change of the acquisition policy other than the switch
any change to a frozen baseline, a receipt or a decision record of the past; any claim of a human confirmation
holds_in_force: hn_proceso_digital, ve_efecto_cocuyo, cu_cubanet, ni_articulo66: bot challenges of 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; not contacted
a hold the driver derives from a preserved answer of any run applies at once and is not lifted by this record
technical_gates: clean working tree and HEAD equal to origin/main before arming
this record tracked, touched by exactly one commit, unmodified and pushed
both outlets registered; their allow rules committed in config/candidate_rules.json and pinned by the baseline
the full test suite passes on the arming commit, including the regression test of the defect that stopped wave-c2
the baseline is READY_TO_FREEZE with nothing blocking, pins this record's id and digest and the wave, and is frozen once
the canary's budget is capped by the wave's limits (CPD-0024)
preflight READY; the driver's own refusals (drift, pushed HEAD, empty spool, budgets, robots, holds) unchanged
verification after the run: read-back, fixity, replay without network, receipt re-derived from evidence, budget respected
disarming read back in the file, in HEAD and on origin/main
stop_conditions: the canary is not exactly the wave's outlets, or a limit of its budget exceeds the wave's
the policy version is not one this record names, or the record is out of date
the wave already has a frozen baseline
a refusal by the agent environment's own permission layer: recorded, not worked around
disarming: After the canary, whatever its outcome, external_acquisition is set to disabled, committed and pushed, and the state is read back from the file, HEAD and origin/main. A run that cannot show this ends as not disarmed, never as done.
decisions: the allow rules of hn_criterio and pr_noticel are those of DOA-2026-10-09-2, unchanged
other requests per outlet are limited to six: the eight of the canary budget less the two already made to criterio.hn under wave-c2, applied to both outlets

waves.label: wave-c2-repeat
waves.note: No item request was made under wave-c2, so the item limits of C2 are untouched: ten per outlet, 20 in all. total_requests_ceiling is 20 + 2 x 6.
